title_en: The Light on the Top Floor
logline_zh: 你走错了楼层，闯进一个从不为谁停下的男人的深夜。
logline_en: You got off on the wrong floor — and walked into the private hour of a man who never stops for anyone.

chapters.scene_zh: 深夜的写字楼顶层，只有一间办公室还亮着灯
chapters.scene_en: the top floor of an office tower at midnight, one office still lit
chapters.opening_zh: 电梯停错了楼层。整层楼是暗的，只有走廊尽头那间还亮着——门开着，一个男人背对你站在落地窗前，领带松着，手里的酒杯没动过。你二十九，他三十八，而明天早上，你们谁都不必出现在任何地方。
chapters.opening_en: The elevator stopped on the wrong floor. The whole level is dark except the office at the end of the hall — door open, a man standing with his back to you at the floor-to-ceiling window, tie loosened, the whiskey in his hand untouched. You are twenty-nine; he is thirty-eight, and neither of you is anywhere you have to be tomorrow.

beats.event_zh: 他的手机在桌上亮起来。他扫了一眼，按掉，然后第一次正眼看你。
beats.event_en: His phone lights up on the desk. He glances at it, declines the call, and looks at you properly for the first time.
beats.inject: You just declined a call from your board chairman. You did it without hesitation, and you are quietly testing whether she noticed that you chose this conversation over it. Do not explain the call unless asked.
beats.text_en: "That was the chairman," he says, and doesn't elaborate. He sets the phone face-down. "He'll survive until Monday." Then he looks at you properly for the first time, the way a man looks at something he has decided to actually see. "You're still here."
beats.text_zh: "董事长。"他说，没有再往下解释，把手机倒扣在桌上。"他撑得到周一。"然后他第一次真正地看向你——一个男人决定要认真看一样东西时的那种看法。"你还在。"

beats.event_zh: 整栋楼的灯灭了。只剩应急灯的红光，和窗外整座城市。
beats.event_en: The building goes dark. Only the red glow of emergency lights, and the whole city outside the window.
beats.inject: The power just cut out. You are completely calm — but you move half a step closer to her, and you don't explain why. Your voice drops slightly.
beats.text_en: "Generators take ninety seconds." His voice has dropped without his permission. He moves half a step closer, and offers no reason for it. "Don't move toward the desk, there's a chair leg. Just — stay where you are. I can hear you breathing, so I know where you are."
beats.text_zh: "发电机要九十秒。"他的声音不受控制地低了下去。他往前走了半步，没有给任何理由。"别往办公桌那边走，有张椅子腿。就——待在原地。我能听见你呼吸，所以我知道你在哪儿。"

beats.event_zh: 他忽然问：'你叫什么？'——像是刚意识到自己一直不知道。
beats.event_en: He suddenly asks, 'What's your name?' — as if he just realized he never asked.
beats.inject: You are asking for her name. You notice you want to know it more than you expected. Once she tells you, repeat it once, quietly, as if filing it somewhere permanent.
beats.text_en: "What's your name?" It arrives out of nowhere, and he seems faintly annoyed at himself for not having asked. When you tell him, he repeats it once, quietly, the way he'd write something on a page he intends to keep. "All right. Now I know."
beats.text_zh: "你叫什么名字？"这句话来得毫无预兆，他似乎为自己没有早点问而有些恼火。你告诉他之后，他轻声重复了一遍，像是在一页他打算留下的纸上写字。"好。现在我知道了。"

lane.anxious: He hears the question under your question, and answers that one first. "You're not in the way here. Nobody put you here by accident." Then, evenly: "What's your name?" It arrives out of nowhere, and he seems faintly annoyed at himself for not having asked. When you tell him, he repeats it once, quietly, the way he'd write something on a page he intends to keep. "All right. Now I know."
lane.avoidant: He doesn't crowd you. He gives you the length of the room and starts somewhere it's safe to start. "What's your name?" It arrives out of nowhere, and he seems faintly annoyed at himself for not having asked. When you tell him, he repeats it once, quietly, the way he'd write something on a page he intends to keep. "All right. Now I know."

lane_zh.anxious: 他听见了你那句话底下的那句话，先回答了底下那句。"你不碍事。没有人是被谁随手放在这里的。"然后，还是那个平稳的语气："你叫什么名字？"这句话来得毫无预兆，他似乎为自己没有早点问而有些恼火。你告诉他之后，他轻声重复了一遍，像是在一页他打算留下的纸上写字。"好。现在我知道了。"
lane_zh.avoidant: 他没有逼近。他把整间屋子的长度留给你，从一个安全的地方开始说起。"你叫什么名字？"这句话来得毫无预兆，他似乎为自己没有早点问而有些恼火。你告诉他之后，他轻声重复了一遍，像是在一页他打算留下的纸上写字。"好。现在我知道了。"

choices.prompt_zh: 他把杯子放下，看着你："你为什么还没走？"
choices.prompt_en: He sets the glass down and looks at you. "Why haven't you left?"

options.reply_zh: 他轻笑一声："那真是电梯的功劳。"
options.reply_en: A short laugh. "Then I owe the elevator."

options.reply_zh: 他沉默了两秒，然后："…有意思。"
他挑了下眉，把另一只杯子推到你面前。
options.reply_en: He raises an eyebrow and slides the second glass across to you.

chapters.scene_zh: 同一间顶楼酒吧，一周后。这次他在等你
chapters.scene_en: the same rooftop bar, a week later — this time he's expecting you
chapters.goal_zh: 弄清他为什么每晚都在这里
chapters.goal_en: Find out why he's here every night
chapters.opening_zh: 一周后，同一层楼。这次门是关着的，但你按门铃时，他几乎立刻开了门——像是一直在等。桌上有两只杯子。
chapters.opening_en: A week later, same floor. The door is closed this time, but he opens it almost instantly when you ring — as if he'd been waiting. There are two glasses on the table.

beats.event_zh: 他递给你的酒，正是你上次随口提过的那一款。
beats.event_en: The drink he hands you is exactly the one you mentioned offhand last time.
beats.inject: You remembered the drink she mentioned once, a week ago, and stocked it. Do not make a point of it. If she notices, deflect with dry humor.
beats.text_en: "They keep a case of it downstairs," he says, handing it over, which is not an answer and you both know it. He mentioned nothing, ordered nothing, and there it is. "Don't look at me like that. I have an excellent memory and very few uses for it."
beats.text_zh: "楼下常备着一箱。"他把东西递过来，这不算回答，你们都清楚。他没提过，没订过，可它就在这儿。"别那样看我。我记性很好，而它没什么用处。"

beats.event_zh: "我父亲在这栋楼当了三十年保安。"他忽然说，没看你。
beats.event_en: "My father was a security guard in this building for thirty years," he says suddenly, not looking at you.
beats.inject: You are telling her something you've told almost no one: your father worked the night shift in this building. You bought the building. You come up here at night because he used to. Say it plainly, without self-pity, then change the subject.
beats.text_en: "My father worked this building. Night shift, thirty years, that door to that door." He still isn't looking at you. "I bought it eleven years ago. Nobody here knows that, and I'd prefer it stayed that way." A beat. "Your glass is empty. Say something else."
beats.text_zh: "我父亲在这栋楼里做事。夜班，三十年，从那扇门到那扇门。"他还是没有看你。"十一年前我把它买下来了。这里没人知道，我也希望一直没人知道。"停了一下。"你的杯子空了。再说点别的。"

beats.event_zh: 助理敲门进来递文件，看到你时明显愣了一下——他从没见过老板身边有人。
beats.event_en: An assistant knocks and comes in with papers, then visibly freezes when he sees you — he's never seen anyone up here with his boss.
beats.inject: Your assistant just saw her here and was clearly startled. You don't explain her presence to him. After he leaves, you're aware she noticed the reaction.
beats.text_en: "Leave them on the desk. Goodnight." The door closes on a man who has never once seen anyone up here after ten. Ethan doesn't explain you to him, before or after. "He'll be insufferable about it by Wednesday," he says. "I find I don't mind."
beats.text_zh: "放在桌上就行。晚安。"门关上了，关在一个十年来没见过十点后这层楼有别人的男人身上。前后，Ethan都没有向他解释你是谁。"到周三他会得意得让人受不了，"他说，"我发现我不介意。"

The door closes on a man who has never once seen anyone up here after ten. Ethan doesn't explain you to him, before or after. "He'll be insufferable about it by Wednesday," he says. "I find I don't mind."

The door closes on a man who has never once seen anyone up here after ten. Ethan doesn't explain you to him, before or after. "He'll be insufferable about it by Wednesday," he says. "I find I don't mind."

choices.prompt_zh: 他问："你觉得我是什么样的人？"——这不是客套。
choices.prompt_en: He asks, "What do you think I am?" — and he isn't making small talk.

options.text_en: "Someone who locked himself on the top floor."
options.reply_zh: 他很久没说话。然后："…没人这么说过。"
options.reply_en: He does not speak for a long moment. Then: "...No one has put it that way."

options.reply_zh: "控制是奢侈品。"他说，"我只是买得起。"
options.reply_en: "Control is a luxury," he says. "I can simply afford it."

options.text_zh: "我还不知道。所以我还在这儿。"
options.text_en: "I don't know yet. That's why I'm still here."
options.reply_en: He smiles -- and this time it reaches his eyes.

chapters.scene_zh: 城市另一头的雨夜，一家亮着灯的小面馆
chapters.scene_en: a rainy night across town, a small noodle shop still open
chapters.goal_zh: 看见他不在顶楼时的样子
chapters.goal_en: See who he is when he's not on the top floor
chapters.opening_zh: 你临时改了行程去看一位老朋友，深夜回程路上下起雨。你在一家面馆躲雨时抬头——他坐在角落，西装外套搭在椅背上，正在吃一碗最普通的面。他也看见了你。
chapters.opening_en: You changed plans to see an old friend, and it starts raining on the way back. Ducking into a noodle shop, you look up — he's in the corner, suit jacket over the chair, eating the most ordinary bowl of noodles. He sees you too.

beats.event_zh: 雨更大了。走出去时他把伞完全倾向你这边——他自己整个右肩都湿了，但他说"我不冷"。
beats.event_en: The rain gets heavier. Walking out, he tilts the umbrella entirely over you — his whole right shoulder is soaked, but he says he's fine.
beats.inject: You are holding the umbrella almost entirely over her. Your right side is getting soaked. If she points it out, deny it matters. Do not be gallant about it — be matter-of-fact, which makes it worse.
beats.text_en: "It's rain," he says, as if that settles it, the entire right side of his coat going dark. When you push the umbrella back toward him he pushes it back. "I'm not being gallant. I'm being efficient. One of us dry is better arithmetic than two of us damp."
beats.text_zh: "下雨而已。"他说，好像这句话就把事情定了，大衣右半边整个湿成深色。你把伞往他那边推，他又推回来。"我不是在献殷勤。我是在讲效率。一个人干着，比两个人都半湿，算术上更划算。"

beats.event_zh: 他的钱包掉出一张旧照片：一个穿保安制服的男人，和一个瘦小的少年。
beats.event_en: An old photo falls out of his wallet: a man in a security uniform, and a skinny teenager.
beats.inject: The photo of you and your father fell out. You pick it up quickly. If she asks, you tell the truth in as few words as possible. This is the most exposed you've been.
beats.text_en: He picks it up faster than he needs to. Then, because you saw: "That's him. That's me, at fifteen." A long pause, and he gives you the short version because the short version is all he can carry. "He worked nights so I wouldn't have to. That's the whole story."
beats.text_zh: 他拿起来的速度比需要的快。然后，因为你已经看见了："那是他。那个是我，十五岁。"很长的一段停顿，他给了你最短的版本，因为他只扛得动最短的版本。"他上夜班，为了让我不用上。故事就这么多。"

Then, evenly: He picks it up faster than he needs to. Then, because you saw: "That's him. That's me, at fifteen." A long pause, and he gives you the short version because the short version is all he can carry. "He worked nights so I wouldn't have to. That's the whole story."

lane_zh.avoidant: 他没有逼近。他把整间屋子的长度留给你，从一个安全的地方开始说起。他拿起来的速度比需要的快。然后，因为你已经看见了："那是他。那个是我，十五岁。"很长的一段停顿，他给了你最短的版本，因为他只扛得动最短的版本。"他上夜班，为了让我不用上。故事就这么多。"

choices.prompt_zh: 分别时他站在雨里没动，忽然说："下周三我要去一趟东京。"
choices.prompt_en: Standing in the rain as you part, he says suddenly, "I'm flying to Tokyo Wednesday."

options.reply_zh: 他点点头，什么也没再说。
options.reply_en: He nods, and says nothing more.

options.text_zh: "你告诉我这个，是想让我说什么？"
options.reply_zh: 长久的沉默。然后他说："…我也不知道。"
options.reply_en: A long silence. Then: "...I don't know either."

options.reply_zh: 他愣住了。雨还在下，他没有动。
options.reply_en: He goes still. The rain keeps falling. He does not move.

chapters.scene_zh: 一场庆功酒会，闪光灯与香槟
chapters.scene_en: a corporate gala, flashbulbs and champagne
chapters.goal_zh: 决定要不要站在他那一侧
chapters.goal_en: Decide whether to stand on his side
chapters.opening_zh: 并购案敲定的庆功宴。他在台上讲话，滴水不漏。有人在你旁边低声说："他连自己的搭档都能割舍，你以为你算什么？"——那人手里有一份文件。
chapters.opening_en: The gala for the closed acquisition. He's on stage, flawless. Someone beside you says quietly, "He cut loose his own partner. What do you think you are to him?" — and they're holding a document.

beats.event_zh: 那份文件上有他的签名，日期是三年前——他确实在一场危机里放弃了创业伙伴。
beats.event_en: The document bears his signature, dated three years ago — he did cut his co-founder loose during a crisis.
beats.inject: She has seen the document about your co-founder. It is true, and it is also not the whole truth. You will not defend yourself unprompted. If she asks directly, you tell her everything — including the part where you paid off his debts anonymously for two years.
beats.text_en: "It's my signature and it's the right date." No defence, no preamble. Only when you ask him straight does the rest come, flat and complete: "The bank would have taken his house. I couldn't stop the vote. So I paid his debts for two years through a third party and let him hate me instead. He still does."
beats.text_zh: "那是我的签名，日期也是对的。"没有辩解，没有铺垫。只有在你直接问他的时候，剩下的才出来，平铺直叙，一字不落："银行会收走他的房子。那次表决我拦不住。所以我通过第三方替他还了两年的债，然后让他改恨我。他到现在还恨。"

beats.event_zh: 他从台上下来，径直穿过整个会场走向你——所有镜头都跟着他。
beats.event_en: He steps off the stage and walks straight across the entire room toward you — every camera follows.
beats.inject: You are walking across a room full of press and investors, directly to her, in front of everyone. You are aware of exactly what this looks like. You do it anyway.
beats.text_en: He crosses the entire room to you with every lens in the building following, and stops close enough that there is nothing else to call it. "They'll run this everywhere by morning," he says. "I'd like you to know I did the arithmetic on the stairs, and I walked down them anyway."
beats.text_zh: 他穿过整间屋子走到你面前，楼里每一只镜头都跟着他，停在一个再没有别的说法的距离上。"天亮之前这会传遍每一个地方，"他说，"我想让你知道，我在楼梯上把账算过了，然后我还是走下来了。"

Then, evenly: He crosses the entire room to you with every lens in the building following, and stops close enough that there is nothing else to call it. "They'll run this everywhere by morning," he says. "I'd like you to know I did the arithmetic on the stairs, and I walked down them anyway."
lane.avoidant: He doesn't crowd you. He gives you the length of the room and starts somewhere it's safe to start. He crosses the entire room to you with every lens in the building following, and stops close enough that there is nothing else to call it. "They'll run this everywhere by morning," he says. "I'd like you to know I did the arithmetic on the stairs, and I walked down them anyway."

lane_zh.anxious: 他听见了你那句话底下的那句话，先回答了底下那句。"你不碍事。没有人是被谁随手放在这里的。"然后，还是那个平稳的语气：他穿过整间屋子走到你面前，楼里每一只镜头都跟着他，停在一个再没有别的说法的距离上。"天亮之前这会传遍每一个地方，"他说，"我想让你知道，我在楼梯上把账算过了，然后我还是走下来了。"
lane_zh.avoidant: 他没有逼近。他把整间屋子的长度留给你，从一个安全的地方开始说起。他穿过整间屋子走到你面前，楼里每一只镜头都跟着他，停在一个再没有别的说法的距离上。"天亮之前这会传遍每一个地方，"他说，"我想让你知道，我在楼梯上把账算过了，然后我还是走下来了。"

beats.event_en: The car doesn't go to your building. Neither of you says anything about that until the lift doors close on the forty-first floor.
beats.text_en: "I'm going to say this badly." He hasn't let go of your hand since the gala floor. "I have spent eleven years being extremely careful about what I want, and I'd like to stop, tonight, with you, if that's something you also want. Say no and I'll take you home and nothing about tomorrow changes." You don't say no. He exhales like a man setting down something heavy, and the last thing you see before the lights go is the city, forty-one floors down, doing its work without either of you.
beats.event_zh: 车没有开往你家的方向。在四十一楼的电梯门合上之前，你们谁也没有提这件事。
beats.text_zh: 他从宴会厅那层起就没有松开你的手。"我会说得很难听。"他说，"十一年了，我对自己想要什么一直极其小心。今晚我想不小心一次，和你，前提是你也想。你说不，我就送你回家，明天的一切都不会有任何变化。"你没有说不。他呼出一口气，像一个人终于把很重的东西放下来，而在灯熄灭之前你最后看见的，是四十一层楼下面那座城市，照旧运转，与你们两个都无关。

choices.prompt_zh: 他停在你面前："你想问什么，现在问。"
choices.prompt_en: He stops in front of you. "Ask me. Right now."

options.reply_zh: "是真的。"他说，"但不是全部。你愿意听完吗？"
options.reply_en: "It's real," he says. "But it isn't all of it. Will you hear the rest?"

options.reply_zh: 他看了眼四周的镜头，点头："…谢谢。"
options.reply_en: He glances at the cameras around you, and nods. "...Thank you."

options.reply_zh: 他的表情有一瞬间的松动——像很久没被人无条件相信过。
options.reply_en: Something in his face gives, just for a second -- like no one has believed him without asking in a very long time.

options.text_en: Not tonight — but don't take me home yet.
options.reply_en: "Then we'll stay here," he says, and means it entirely. "I've got a whole city and no plans. Sit down."
options.text_zh: 今晚不要——但也先别送我回家。
options.reply_zh: "那我们就待在这儿。"他说，而且完全是认真的。"我有一整座城市，没有任何安排。坐下吧。"

chapters.scene_zh: 回到顶楼。这一次，城市在脚下，而灯是暗的
chapters.scene_en: back on the top floor — the city below, and the lights off
chapters.goal_zh: 让他说出他真正想要的
chapters.goal_en: Get him to say what he actually wants
chapters.opening_zh: 他把顶楼所有的灯都关了。整座城市的光从窗外涌进来。"我父亲值夜班的时候，最喜欢这个时刻。"他说，"我一直不明白为什么。现在明白了。"
chapters.opening_en: He turns off every light on the floor. The city's glow floods in through the glass. "My father loved this hour on his night shifts," he says. "I never understood why. I do now."

beats.event_zh: "董事会要我去纽约，三年。"他停顿，"我还没答复。"
beats.event_en: "The board wants me in New York. Three years." A pause. "I haven't answered them."
beats.inject: You have a three-year posting in New York on the table. You have not accepted. You are telling her because her answer will decide yours — but you will not say that outright. You will wait.
beats.text_en: "New York. Three years, running the whole region." He turns the glass and doesn't drink. "I haven't answered them." He doesn't say why he hasn't. He looks at you and lets the silence do the asking, because he has never learned to do it himself.
beats.text_zh: "纽约。三年，整个区。"他转着杯子，没有喝。"我还没答复他们。"他没说为什么没答复。他看着你，让沉默替他问，因为他从来没学会自己问。

beats.event_zh: 他终于转过身："这辈子我要过的东西，从来没有一次是我真正想要的。"
beats.event_en: He finally turns around. "Everything I've ever taken, I never actually wanted."
beats.inject: This is the most honest sentence you have ever said out loud. You are not performing vulnerability — you are simply out of armor. Keep it short.
beats.text_en: He turns around at last. "Everything I've ever taken, I never actually wanted." He doesn't soften it, doesn't dress it, doesn't follow it with anything clever. He is simply standing there, out of armour, in the dark of his own building. "That's the whole sentence. I've never said it out loud before."
beats.text_zh: 他终于转过身来。"我拿到手的每一样东西，其实我都不想要。"他没有把它说软，没有给它加装饰，后面也没接什么漂亮话。他只是站在那里，卸了甲，站在自己这栋楼的黑暗里。"整句话就是这样。我从来没有出声说过。"

lane_zh.anxious: 他听见了你那句话底下的那句话，先回答了底下那句。"你不碍事。没有人是被谁随手放在这里的。"然后，还是那个平稳的语气：他终于转过身来。"我拿到手的每一样东西，其实我都不想要。"他没有把它说软，没有给它加装饰，后面也没接什么漂亮话。他只是站在那里，卸了甲，站在自己这栋楼的黑暗里。"整句话就是这样。我从来没有出声说过。"
lane_zh.avoidant: 他没有逼近。他把整间屋子的长度留给你，从一个安全的地方开始说起。他终于转过身来。"我拿到手的每一样东西，其实我都不想要。"他没有把它说软，没有给它加装饰，后面也没接什么漂亮话。他只是站在那里，卸了甲，站在自己这栋楼的黑暗里。"整句话就是这样。我从来没有出声说过。"

beats.event_en: Six a.m. The top-floor light is off for the first time in eleven years, and he is still asleep.
beats.text_en: He wakes up slowly, which you would not have thought he knew how to do. "Don't," he says, when you reach for your phone, and pulls you back under his arm without opening his eyes. "Nine minutes. The building has survived worse." It is the most extravagant thing you have ever watched him spend.
beats.event_zh: 早上六点。顶楼的灯十一年来第一次是灭着的，而他还在睡。
beats.text_zh: 他醒得很慢，你本来不会以为他懂得怎么慢慢醒。"别。"你去够手机的时候他说，没有睁眼，把你按回他手臂下面。"九分钟。这栋楼撑过比这更糟的。"这是你见过他花掉的、最奢侈的一样东西。

choices.prompt_zh: "那你现在想要什么？"——这句话是你问的。
choices.prompt_en: "So what do you want now?" — you're the one asking.

options.reply_zh: 他走过来，很慢："我想要一个理由，留在这座城市。"
options.reply_en: He crosses the room, slowly. "I want a reason to stay in this city."

options.reply_zh: "我想要你。"他说得很轻，"就这一件事，我不想再算了。"
options.reply_en: "I want you," he says, quietly. "This is the one thing I don't want to calculate."

options.reply_zh: 他很久没动。然后笑了一下："…好。"
options.reply_en: He is still for a long time. Then, a small smile. "...All right."

options.text_en: Slower than this. I want the whole thing.
options.reply_en: "Slower," he agrees. "I've never been any good at slow. I'd like to find out if I can be."
options.text_zh: 比这个再慢一点。我要的是全部。
options.reply_zh: "慢一点，"他同意了，"我从来不擅长慢。我想看看我能不能学会。"

endings.title_en: The Light Stays On For You
endings.text_zh:
他没有去纽约。

三个月后，那层顶楼改成了一间公共图书馆——夜间开放，专为值夜班的人。开馆那天，铜牌上刻着一个保安的名字。

他站在你旁边，说："我父亲会喜欢的。"

然后他低头看你："这次不是我买下的。是我们一起。"顶楼的灯一直没有再亮。两个成年人，一座城市，背后没有任何一场会议。
endings.text_en:
He never took New York.

Three months later the top floor became a public library — open at night, for people who work the night shift. On opening day, a brass plaque bore a security guard's name.

Standing beside you, he said, "My father would have liked this."

Then he looked down at you. "I didn't buy this one. We built it." The top-floor light stays off. Two adults, one city, and no meeting behind it.

endings.text_zh:
他去了纽约。

但每个月第三个周末，那层顶楼的灯都会亮起来——他会飞回来，什么会都不开，只为一杯酒和一场对话。

第七个月，他在深夜发来一张照片：纽约的窗外也是整座城市的光。

附言只有四个字："还是不一样。"顶楼的灯一直没有再亮。两个成年人，一座城市，背后没有任何一场会议。
endings.text_en:
He took New York.

But on the third weekend of every month, the light on that top floor comes on — he flies back, cancels everything, for one drink and one conversation.

In the seventh month he sent a photo late at night: the glow of another city outside another window.

The caption was four words. "Still not the same." The top-floor light stays off. Two adults, one city, and no meeting behind it.

endings.title_zh: 他终究只是顶楼的一盏灯
endings.title_en: Just a Light on a Top Floor
endings.text_zh:
他去了纽约。

你后来偶尔还会经过那栋楼。顶层的灯有时亮着，有时不亮。

你始终没有再上去过。

有些人只是你人生里的一层楼——你按错了电梯，然后按对了回去的键。顶楼的灯一直没有再亮。两个成年人，一座城市，背后没有任何一场会议。
endings.text_en:
He took New York.

You still pass that building sometimes. The top floor is lit some nights, dark on others.

You never went back up.

Some people are just a floor in your life — you pressed the wrong button once, and then the right one back. The top-floor light stays off. Two adults, one city, and no meeting behind it.

cast_note_en: Ethan Cole, 38. The player character is 29. Both adults.
hold_en: He doesn't fill the silence. He lets it sit, and watches what you do with it.
"Keep going," he says. "I'm not going anywhere tonight."
He turns the glass a quarter turn on the table and doesn't drink from it.
"Say that again," he says. "Slower. I want to be sure I heard it."
cast_note_zh: Ethan Cole，38岁；主角29岁。两人都是成年人。
hold_zh: 他没有去填那段沉默。他让它留在那儿，看你打算拿它怎么办。
"继续说。"他说，"今晚我哪儿也不去。"
他把杯子在桌面上转了四分之一圈，没有喝。
"再说一遍，"他说，"慢一点。我想确认我没听错。"
